card: Increases the tip change wait timeout and switches duration measurements to time.monotonic() in interface_ipc_mining.py. On slow or heavily loaded test hosts, the test could fail spuriously due to an IPC timeout before block generation registers. The author confirms the failure can be reproduced using faketime to simulate slow execution. This is a small reliability fix for the functional test suite.
changed_since_previous: No changes to the commits or diff; re-evaluated with the patch details.
evidence: Author provides a reproduction command using faketime: 'faketime --exclude-monotonic -f "+0 x0.1" build/test/functional/interface_ipc_mining.py'
PR description notes this was a follow-up suggested during review of PR #36731
problem: On slow or heavily loaded hosts, waitTipChanged can hit the default IPC timeout before node block generation completes, causing intermittent test failures. Measuring elapsed test durations using wall-clock time can also produce incorrect intervals if system time shifts during execution.

risk.why: A mistake only affects the interface_ipc_mining test, potentially causing false CI failures.

summary: Increases the tip change timeout in interface_ipc_mining.py to at least 60 seconds. Switches interval duration measurements in the test from time.time() to time.monotonic().
